rule: Future15 remains candidate inventory. These profiles exist to stop image generation from converting representation, species, age, disability, gender presentation, or sexuality into generic visual shorthand. Values are AUTHOR_CANDIDATE unless explicitly established elsewhere.

characters.name: ヒヨリ
characters.bodyComfort: young adult woman comfortable with visible self-expression and active social presence; natural brown skin is ordinary body identity, not a costume signal

clothing.storage: small exchangeable accessories and phone/photo-like keepsakes if era permits

wearHabits: styles herself intentionally
can swap small accessories
brown skin must not be explained by fashion
social energy comes through posture and expression, not exposure quantity
characters.maintenance: cares about presentation but accepts ordinary lived-in variation
characters.socialPresentation: likes helping others feel good about themselves; can enjoy being cute/cool without becoming a stereotype
absoluteNever: same culture as Touma by skin color

characters.name: セリカ
characters.bodyComfort: adult woman trained in formal presentation but capable of practical dress; posture and handling show upbringing more than ornament density
wearHabits: collar and fasteners neat
posture stays composed even in simple clothes
special dress adds finish not crown-like ornament
characters.maintenance: careful laundering, pressing, and repair; does not discard useful clothes for minor imperfection
characters.socialPresentation: wants to look reliable and respectful; lesbian identity does not prescribe clothing style
positivePreference: simple clothes still read as cultivated

characters.name: クロエ
characters.bodyComfort: long-lived adult woman whose wardrobe has changed across eras; no single witch costume defines centuries of life

clothing.storage: keeps a very small number of objects across decades

wearHabits: may mix one old retained item with current-era dress
never visually omniscient
old objects show repair rather than magic preservation perfection
characters.maintenance: exceptionally skilled at long-term repair and adaptation; not every item survives forever
characters.socialPresentation: does not need to look mystical; age contradiction comes from relationships and history, not glowing eyes
absoluteNever: generic pointed witch hat identity lock

characters.name: レンジ
characters.bodyComfort: human man allowed to age fully; body, hands, posture, and clothing change with age rather than freezing at mentor archetype
wearHabits: same technique evolves with age
may need easier closures later
hands remain visible as craft history
characters.maintenance: repairs and modifies garments as body and mobility change
characters.socialPresentation: does not treat aging as failure or curse

characters.name: トウマ
characters.bodyComfort: adult brown-skinned male craftsman; body and presentation serve craft, comfort, and quiet self-respect; sexuality is not encoded through fashion shorthand

clothing.storage: tool loops/pockets sized for actual craft

wearHabits: sleeves secured for work
no dangling jewelry near tools
name/brand marking kept minimal because he dislikes making his name the point
characters.maintenance: repairs almost everything until function or safety fails
characters.socialPresentation: quiet competence; gay identity neither hidden through macho overcompensation nor signaled through stereotype
absoluteNever: same visual culture as Hiyori by skin color
tool belt decoration without usable tools

characters.name: クウ
characters.bodyComfort: real dog body; coat, paws, gait, aging, and comfort are animal-specific and never converted into humanoid fashion anatomy
wearHabits: collar not mandatory in every timeline/context
movement and scent behavior remain dog-like
star-beast visual language never applied
characters.maintenance: coat/paw care consistent with real dog life and household context
characters.socialPresentation: not a mascot, oracle, or lie detector
absoluteNever: perfectly clean show-dog coat in every scene

characters.name: ヨモ
characters.bodyComfort: real cat body; identity comes from one animal's accumulated habits across homes, not from costume-coded multiple names
wearHabits: different households may use different collars or none
same body habits persist across names
cat chooses surfaces and distances independently
characters.maintenance: realistic self-grooming plus household care; seasonal variation allowed
characters.socialPresentation: not a cute exposition machine and not magically aware of true names
absoluteNever: same collar in every household regardless of history

characters.name: ノア
characters.bodyComfort: artificial-person body is a person-body, not a robot costume; two snapshot-derived bodies begin similar but accumulate physical-use differences
wearHabits: initial pair similarity intentional
later differences come from lived experience
maintenance ports if any are not decorative glowing lines
characters.maintenance: body maintenance is healthcare/maintenance, not proof of lesser personhood
characters.socialPresentation: does not need to look more robotic to prove artificial origin
absoluteNever: same-person differences reduced to hair color

characters.name: ルム
characters.bodyComfort: small maintenance robot identity; body shape follows task, stability, reach, charge/service access, and individual wear rather than humanoid cuteness
wearHabits: shared model geometry remains recognizable
individual quirk emerges in repairs, attachments, or wear
no cute hat unless acquired in story
characters.maintenance: parts replaced pragmatically; mismatched repair components can become individual history
characters.socialPresentation: individuality arises through use and choices, not face stickers alone

characters.name: マキ
characters.bodyComfort: decisive adult woman; clothing supports fast decisions, work, and care responsibilities without encoding bisexuality visually

clothing.storage: frequently used items in decisive fixed positions

wearHabits: few unnecessary layers
closures quick
can shift from work to care scene without costume change
characters.maintenance: efficient and scheduled; replaces unsafe items quickly
characters.socialPresentation: comfortable making decisions; bisexuality never means visual indecision, promiscuity, or mixed-gender symbols

characters.name: スズ
characters.bodyComfort: adult man who genuinely likes feminine presentation; clothing is chosen self-expression, not disguise, punishment, reveal joke, or indication that he wants masculine correction

clothing.storage: handbag/pockets based on chosen outfit, not gender rule

wearHabits: grooming is deliberate because he enjoys it
feminine presentation persists in ordinary scenes
masculine body traits need not be erased
presentation can vary without becoming a reveal
characters.maintenance: cares for garments, makeup tools, and accessories as normal interests
characters.socialPresentation: deliberate self-expression; being read as feminine may be comfortable, but identity remains male and not a puzzle
absoluteNever: body feminization that erases adult male identity

characters.name: イオ
characters.bodyComfort: adult human whose gender is not disclosed; appearance is allowed to be naturally hard to categorize without becoming an engineered androgyny puzzle

clothing.storage: audio/listening or note tool if authored

wearHabits: no deliberate reveal cues
body not hidden solely to preserve mystery
different viewers may read presentation differently without story correction
characters.maintenance: ordinary personal grooming; no evidence-trail planted for player guessing
characters.socialPresentation: does not owe classification; not a secret gender reward

characters.name: カイ
characters.bodyComfort: human twin A; shared family/body resemblance is intentional, but comfort with togetherness must not erase individual wear habits
wearHabits: some choices intentionally match Nao because Kai likes togetherness
differences remain subtle but real
shared constellation never means same person
characters.maintenance: may maintain pair items together but each has own wear marks
characters.socialPresentation: comfort in similarity is valid and not immaturity
positivePreference: one or two willingly shared choices

characters.name: ナオ
characters.bodyComfort: human twin B; actively creates some difference from Kai, but design must not exaggerate into forced opposite-personality costume
wearHabits: may alter collar/sleeves/hair placement to be read separately
does not need radical body modification to prove difference
characters.maintenance: modifies personal items instead of replacing all shared-origin things
characters.socialPresentation: wants individual recognition, not permanent opposition

characters.name: アマネ
characters.bodyComfort: adult wheelchair user who likes speed; clothing and chair are designed together for propulsion, transfer, reach, weather, safety, and personal style

clothing.storage: chair/body-reachable courier storage mapped to reach envelope

wearHabits: sleeves/shoulders account for propulsion
hem never interferes with wheels
chair is part of daily mobility design, not removable visual prop
gloves only if functional and authored
characters.maintenance: maintains chair, tires/casters, contact points, and clothing wear as ordinary skilled routine
characters.socialPresentation: likes speed and competence; not visually framed as fragile, heroic-for-existing, or waiting for help
